description: This file contains functions for launching and managing a browser application, including setting up the app window, handling errors, installing app icons, and synchronizing local storage with settings within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: launchApp
methods.description: Launches a browser app with specified options, setting window size, position, and handling special cases for Chromium on macOS.

methods.name: installAppIcon
methods.description: Reads an app icon image and sets it as the dock tile on macOS for Chromium browsers.

methods.name: syncLocalStorageWithSettings
methods.description: Synchronizes local storage of a page with a JSON settings file, allowing persistence of user settings.
